# nexus container

Verbs: get, start, stop, restart, remove, update

## Usage

```
nexus container [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for container
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus container get`](nexus_container_get.md) | List containers, or with NAME, get a container |
| [`nexus container remove`](nexus_container_remove.md) | Remove a container |
| [`nexus container restart`](nexus_container_restart.md) | Restart a container |
| [`nexus container start`](nexus_container_start.md) | Start a container |
| [`nexus container stop`](nexus_container_stop.md) | Stop a container |
| [`nexus container update`](nexus_container_update.md) | Update a container to its image's newest digest |
